description: Implement Follow System and Feed APIs with follow/unfollow operations, followers/following lists, follow suggestions, check follow status, personalized home feed, and explore/trending feed
steps: Create src/controllers/followController.js with followUser (POST /api/v1/follow/:userId), unfollowUser (DELETE /api/v1/follow/:userId), getFollowers (GET /api/v1/follow/:userId/followers?limit&offset), getFollowing (GET /api/v1/follow/:userId/following?limit&offset), checkFollowStatus (GET /api/v1/follow/status/:userId), and getSuggestedUsers (GET /api/v1/follow/suggestions?limit) handlers. All use asyncHandler, protect middleware for mutations, AppError, and successResponse

Create src/services/followService.js with functions: followUser (begin transaction, check if already following, insert into follows table with follower_id and following_id, increment users.followers_count for following_id and users.following_count for follower_id, commit, return follow record), unfollowUser (transaction, delete from follows, decrement both counters with GREATEST(count - 1, 0)), getFollowers (query users joined with follows WHERE following_id=$1, paginate), getFollowing (query WHERE follower_id=$1, paginate), checkFollowStatus (query follows table for record), getSuggestedUsers (query users not followed by current user, order by followers_count DESC or random, exclude self, limit results). Handle edge cases: cannot follow self, cannot follow twice

Create src/routes/followRoutes.js with Express Router: POST /:userId (protect, followUser), DELETE /:userId (protect, unfollowUser), GET /:userId/followers (getFollowers public), GET /:userId/following (getFollowing public), GET /status/:userId (protect, checkFollowStatus), GET /suggestions (protect, getSuggestedUsers)

Create src/controllers/feedController.js with getHomeFeed (GET /api/v1/feed/home?limit&offset&cursor) and getExploreFeed (GET /api/v1/feed/explore?limit&offset) handlers. Both require protect middleware, use pagination, return posts with author details and engagement metrics

Create src/services/feedService.js with functions: getHomeFeed (query posts from users the authenticated user follows plus their own posts, ORDER BY created_at DESC for chronological feed, include post details with author, like_count, comment_count, share_count, check if current user liked/bookmarked each post, support cursor-based or offset pagination), getExploreFeed (query public posts from all users, order by engagement score calculated from like_count + comment_count*2 + share_count*3 + view_count*0.1 and recency, filter recent posts from last 7 days, exclude posts from users current user follows to show new content, paginate). Both return posts array with full post objects matching existing post response format
Create src/routes/feedRoutes.js with Express Router: GET /home (protect, getHomeFeed), GET /explore (protect, getExploreFeed)
Register followRoutes and feedRoutes in src/routes/index.js: import both, add router.use('/follow', followRoutes) and router.use('/feed', feedRoutes)
acceptance_criteria: Follow/unfollow operations correctly update followers_count and following_count in users table
Cannot follow the same user twice - returns appropriate error
Followers and following lists return user objects with username, full_name, avatar_url, is_verified
Follow suggestions exclude already-followed users and self
Home feed returns posts from followed users in chronological order
Explore feed returns trending posts from non-followed users based on engagement
All feed responses include whether current user has liked/bookmarked each post
Pagination works correctly with limit/offset for all list endpoints
verification: Manual test: POST /api/v1/follow/:userId successfully follows user and increments counters
Manual test: DELETE /api/v1/follow/:userId unfollows and decrements counters
Manual test: GET /api/v1/feed/home returns posts from followed users only
Manual test: GET /api/v1/feed/explore returns trending posts with high engagement
Verify follow suggestions exclude already followed users by checking suggestions list after following a user
